summary: Agent-focused instructions for the Reasoner project. Covers project overview, tech stack (FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, Stripe, SearXNG, Tailwind CSS v4), project structure, build/test commands, code style, testing strategy (pytest, 147 tests), environment variables, security considerations, and architecture patterns (Event Sourcing, CQRS, Hexagonal Architecture, Mixin Pattern, HyperGate, Token Optimization).

Architectural audit report V5 for Reasoner. Identifies CRITICAL, HIGH, and MEDIUM findings across runtime stability, API resilience, UI rendering, VS module complexity, and SaaS infrastructure. Proposes Strategy A (tactical patches), Strategy B (component extraction), and Strategy C (structural refactor) with timeline estimates.

Comprehensive audit report covering status overview, stability, resilience, code health, deployment, maintainability, tech debt, and knowledge gaps. Identifies God objects (api/__init__.py, pipeline.py, renderer.py, presets.py) and provides risk heatmap.

Mindmap-style overview of the Reasoner codebase structure. Organizes files into frontend (ui-next), backend (src/reasoner), shared, and infrastructure categories. Lists key entry points and module responsibilities.

Color palette definitions for dark and light themes. Defines semantic tokens: bg, surface, surface-2, text, text-2, text-muted, text-subtle, accent, accent-hover, accent-dim, red, red-bg, red-border, green, border, shadow, method-accent-rgb.

Deployment strategy for Reasoner v2.1 covering 9 phases: Foundation, Auth, Quotas, Billing, Stripe Webhooks, Security, Monitoring, Frontend Polish, and Scale. Details infrastructure components (PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, Stripe, SearXNG, Docker Compose).

Design system documentation for Reasoner frontend. Covers color system, spacing scale, typography scale, component library, animation tokens, layout grid, theme provider, and CSS variables. Uses Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS-native configuration.

Overview of all documentation files in the Reasoner project. Lists each document with its purpose and target audience (agent vs human). Maps documents to onboarding, architecture, strategy, UX, operations, and integration categories.

Research document on end-to-end encryption options for Reasoner. Evaluates Signal Protocol, Double Ratchet, X3DH, MLS, OAuth 2.0 PAR, Post-Quantum Cryptography (CRYSTALS-Kyber, CRYSTALS-Dilithium), Cloudflare Keyless SSL, HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, and HSMs.

Comprehensive documentation of environment variables for Reasoner. Covers LLM API keys (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, etc.), security settings (ADMIN_API_KEY, CSRF_SECRET), server config, rate limiting, search config, SaaS auth (Supabase, JWT), database/cache (PostgreSQL, Redis), Stripe billing, and monitoring (Sentry).
Instructions for integrating Graphify into the Reasoner project. Describes running the Graphify CLI, output directory (graphify-out/), and generated files (GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.json, graph.html).

Guide for integrating a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with Reasoner. Covers SSE and stdio transports, tools/resources/prompts, Zod validation, and integration with Claude Desktop, Cline, and Copilot.

Monitoring and alerting guide for Reasoner. Documents Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, Alertmanager rules, Sentry integration, health checks, circuit breaker monitoring, memory usage, latency, and error rate tracking.

Integration plan for OpenRouter as the primary LLM provider for Reasoner. Covers OpenAI-compatible API usage, LLM registry updates, model whitelist, cost tracking, provider fallback mechanisms, and streaming support.

Progress tracker for Reasoner development milestones. Tracks status of OpenRouter integration, SaaS 9-Phase Roadmap, Strategy A, Strategy B, SearXNG integration, VS (Verbalized Sampling), E2E encryption, Graphify, MCP server, Next.js 16 migration, and Tailwind v4 migration.

High-level roadmap for Reasoner SaaS covering 9 phases: Foundation, Auth, Quotas, Billing, Stripe Webhooks, Security, Monitoring, Frontend Polish, and Scale. Defines goals, deliverables, and timeline for each phase.

Detailed SaaS 9-phase roadmap for Reasoner. Each phase includes specific tasks, files to modify, and infrastructure components. Covers domain entities, Supabase auth, Postgres quota repo, Redis caching, Stripe billing, webhooks, security hardening, monitoring, frontend polish, and horizontal scaling.

Strategy A tactical refactor plan. Focuses on fixing critical runtime hazards without architectural changes: EventBus subscriber isolation, circular import check, cancellation TOCTOU race fix, EventStore concurrency fix, and RunStateStore wrapper extraction.

Strategy B extraction plan for decomposing God objects. Targets pipeline.py, renderer.py, api/__init__.py, and presets.py. Proposes extracting PipelineFlow, RendererService, SearchService, and PresetService to reduce file sizes and improve maintainability.

Setup mindmap for Reasoner. Covers prerequisites (Python 3.10+, Git, API keys), installation (pip install -r requirements.txt), configuration (.env), verification (server_check.py), server start options (uvicorn, start_server.py), CLI usage, API usage, and troubleshooting.

Execution summary for Strategy A. Steps 1-4 are complete (Bus.py isolation, circular import check, cancellation TOCTOU race fix, EventStore concurrency fix). Step 5 (RunStateStore wrapper) is pending. Includes testing strategy, deployment notes, and monitoring recommendations.

Recommended temperature values for each Reasoner pipeline phase: Phase 0 Classification (0.3), Phase 1 Decomposition (0.4), Phase 2 Perspectives (1.0), Phase 3 Critique (0.3), Phase 4 Stress Testing (0.5), Phase 5 Synthesis (0.5).

UI/UX audit and optimization plan for Reasoner frontend. Identifies WCAG AA contrast failures, inconsistent focus states, touch targets below 40x40px, misleading ThreeBackground naming, tooltip bugs, and ad-hoc typography. Provides recommended fixes with priority levels.

UX optimization report for Reasoner frontend. Prioritizes cost/token transparency, error recovery with retry/edit, inline source citations, compact phase cards, drag-and-drop uploads, inline memory indicator, command palette, keyboard shortcuts, feedback loop, and continue generating. Provides implementation roadmap across 4 sprints.

UX optimization research document. Identifies rendering performance bottlenecks (chat page monolith, streaming markdown re-renders, PhaseTimeline re-computation), visual design issues (accent color, error color, legacy tokens), interaction gaps (skeleton loading, alert validation, horizontal scroll, completion signal), reasoning transparency issues, and accessibility improvements.

Verbalized Sampling (VS) architecture document. Describes the reasoning primitive that replaces single-shot generation with k candidates + probability-weighted selection + NLI verification. Covers feature flags, deployment profiles (LATENCY_SENSITIVE, BALANCED, MAX_ACCURACY), vertical configs (Radiology, Legal, Aerospace), generation strategies, and fallback behavior.

Greek-language example questions for each Reasoner reasoning method (Multi-Perspective, Iterative, Debate, Scientific, Socratic, Research, Jury, Pre-Mortem, Bayesian, Dialectical, Analogical, Delphi). Each entry explains why the question fits the method.

Architecture codemap for Reasoner. Describes monorepo structure (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend + SearXNG), high-level data flow (Browser → FastAPI → HyperGate → ARAPipeline → Neuro/Widgets), dependency rules (Hexagonal DDD), service boundaries, 17 reasoning methods, and key entry points.

Backend codemap for Reasoner. Documents FastAPI API routes (core pipeline, history, uploads, widgets, auth, billing, WebSocket, metrics), middleware chain, core orchestration (ARAPipeline + mixins), HyperGate pre-router, application layer (CQRS, event bus, ports, services), and key supporting modules.

Data architecture codemap for Reasoner. Describes storage layers: SQLite (event store, feedback, auth), PostgreSQL (production, quotas, subscriptions), Redis (cache, run state), Token Cache (in-process), Neuro LTM (long-term memory), IndexedDB (browser), and file uploads. Also covers key domain models (PipelineState, aggregates, events, presets).

Dependencies and integrations codemap for Reasoner. Lists external services (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, Ollama, SearXNG, Supabase, Stripe, Redis, DeepL, Sentry), internal service wiring (Neuro, Widgets, Auth, Billing, Quota), and security integrations.

Frontend architecture codemap for Reasoner (ui-next). Documents framework (Next.js 16, App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS v4), page tree, component hierarchy, state management (Zustand + IndexedDB), hooks, test files (Vitest), and lib utilities.

SearXNG P0 implementation plan. Describes DiscoveryClient with BM25/freshness scoring, smart_search with query decomposition, engine diversity config, and planned optimizations: circuit breaker, Redis cache, in-flight deduplication, time_range/language propagation, hybrid Perplexity+SearXNG mode.

VS constants decisions document. Defines k defaults per stage, VSDeploymentProfile (LATENCY_SENSITIVE, BALANCED, MAX_ACCURACY), GenerationStrategy default (BEST_VERIFIABLE), tail thresholds per vertical (Radiology 0.10, Legal 0.08, Aerospace 0.06), JSON parse error strategy, and calibration weights (W_ENTROPY 0.30, W_SUPPORT 0.25, W_NLI 0.35, W_RANK 0.10).

Monitoring reference directory. Contains alerts-reference.yml with Prometheus alerting rules for Reasoner backend. Defines required metrics (reasoner_queries_total, reasoner_quota_exceeded_total, reasoner_query_duration_seconds_bucket, reasoner_postgres_pool_free). Notes that Prometheus and Alertmanager are not included in docker-compose.

Graphify README (third-party tool). Describes knowledge graph extraction from code, docs, PDFs, images, and videos. Outputs graph.html, GRAPH_REPORT.md, and graph.json. Supports multiple platforms (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) and provides CLI commands for querying and merging graphs.

Legacy alerting module for Reasoner. Implements AlertManager with AlertConfig, AlertSeverity, AlertRule, Alert, and notifiers (LoggingNotifier, SlackNotifier, WebhookNotifier). Includes predefined alert rules for system down, memory exhausted, high error rate, high latency, circuit breaker open, and LLM provider failure.

Legacy audit logging module. Implements AuditEventType enum, AuditEvent dataclass, AuditLogger with memory trimming and file output, AuditTimer context manager, and convenience functions (get_audit_logger, log_api_request, log_api_response, log_pipeline_event).
Simple script to check if OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable is set. Prints status and warnings if missing.

Legacy provider health checker for LLM providers. Implements ProviderHealthChecker with caching, API key checks, and test calls to registry models. Returns HealthCheckResult with overall status and per-provider health.

Legacy observability decorator module. Provides @observe decorator for automatic metric collection, trace spans (start_span, end_span), metric emission (emit_metric), trace context propagation, and buffer management for metrics and spans.
Legacy token bucket rate limiter. Implements TokenBucket, RateLimiter with per-minute, per-hour, and burst buckets. Provides get_rate_limiter factory and optional SlowAPI integration.
Legacy retry utilities with exponential backoff and jitter. Implements retry_with_backoff function, RetryConfig dataclass, and CircuitOpenError. Integrates with circuit breaker for protected retries.
Legacy script that scans Python files and generates reverse dependency mapping (reverse_deps.txt) by detecting import statements.
Legacy server startup script. Runs uvicorn with api:app on host 0.0.0.0 port 8000. Lists available endpoints.
Legacy Python file summarizer. Scans .py files, extracts docstrings, classes, functions, and imports, then writes summaries to py_summaries.txt.
Legacy debug script for testing extract_json from parsing module. Demonstrates extracting JSON and cleaning action blueprint steps.
Alembic environment configuration for async migrations. Sets up DATABASE_URL, async engine from config, and run functions for offline and online modes. Uses SQLAlchemy async engine with NullPool.
Alembic migration adding PayPal support to subscriptions table. Renames external_subscription_id to stripe_sub_id and external_customer_id to stripe_customer_id. Adds paypal_sub_id column and index.

Per-run cancellation state management for the Reasoner API. Implements RunStateStore with asyncio.Lock, managing cancel events, active runs, and run owners. Provides add, remove, get_cancel_event, request_cancel, request_cancel_all, is_active, get_owner, active_runs, and reset methods. Module-level singleton _run_store.
